title: Layer 2 round 1 major SE+DE: the milestone parse guesses instead of failing — silent skip, name truncation, count loss
description: parse_milestones (acquire.rs:103,110) contradicts its own never-a-guess declaration three ways: (a) non-# lines are skipped, so whole-format drift returns Some(empty) as Acquired with the phase-pointer check disarmed; (b) rfind(' (') truncates a name legitimately ending in a parenthetical ('cleanup (phase two)' -> 'cleanup'); (c) display_active_milestone lacks the schema-mandated precomputed open-finding count. Disposition: zero parseable lines in non-empty output = None/unusable; anchor the count suffix to the digit-slash-digit shape; carry the count field or declare its bootstrap absence. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: software-engineer.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in d84109f5: parse_milestones is fail-loud — output with content lines but zero parseable milestone lines returns None and the acquisition reports Unusable, never an empty success; the count suffix strips only the exact (N/M) digit shape so a name ending in a real parenthetical survives; the active-milestone display carries the open-count gauge (total minus closed, saturating).
